E-16.section_name: Multivariate modeling of dependence structure with vine copulas

                    \item The lower and upper critical thresholds for this two sided test, $c_{\text{l}}$ and $c_{\text{u}}$, to achieve target significance level $\alpha$ are given by $c_{l}=\hat{F}^{-1}_{\tau,n}\left( \frac{\alpha}{2} \right)$ and $c_{u}=\hat{F}^{-1}_{\tau,n}\left( 1- \frac{\alpha}{2} \right)$
                    \item rejection region $R={t:(t<c_{l}) \text{ or } (t>c_{u}})$
                    \item p-value is given by the null distribution operated at the test statistic of the observed sample, $t_{obs}$, $\text{p-value}=\hat{F}_{\tau,n}(t_{obs})$.

E-27.section_name: Creating time series for each generated event
E-27.verbatim_span:
Clip events that exceed duration limits.
        \begin{enumerate}
        	\item For surge and rain events, the maximum duration, $D^{\text{max}}_{\text{obs}}$, was a user defined parameter in threshold-based multi-driver event selection, $D_{e}^{\text{max}}$. For combined events, the maximum duration computed by multiplying $D^{\text{max}}_{\text{obs}}$ by a user defined multiplier, $m_{\text{comb}}$, to allow for longer-than-observed combined events.
        	\item For rain events, clip to the $D^{\text{max}}_{\text{obs}}$-hour period that maximizes storm surge while including all timesteps with non-zero rainfall.
        	\item Clip combined events to the $m_{\text{comb}}D^{\text{max}}_{\text{obs}}$-hour period and surge events to $D^{\text{max}}_{\text{obs}}$-hour period that maximizes rainfall while including all timesteps with storm surge above the lower limit used to define the start and end of a surge event in threshold-based multi-driver event selection, $s_{\text{lim}}$. If the latter region exceeds the duration threshold, choose the period that maximizes storm surge.
